profile.commute: BART Orange line plus a bike
profile.hobby: Tuesday pub quiz with a team called The Cache Misses

memories.text: Pascal knocked the smallest tomato seedling off the fire escape rail and I found the pot in three pieces on the neighbour's landing.
Decided to move the thumbnail queue off Redis and onto SQS, mostly so that a restart stops losing about four hundred jobs every time.
There are four San Marzano tomato plants on the fire escape and only the one nearest the drainpipe has actually set fruit.
The Cache Misses came second at the pub quiz and we lost it on a question about which river runs through Ljubljana.
Dez at Bicycle Coffee on 25th remembered my cortado without asking and then talked me into trying it with the Ethiopian roast.
Decided to retire the old staging cluster and fold eleven nodes down to four, keeping only the ones with the newer NVMe disks.
The boiler technician did not show up in the four hour window and the dispatcher told me the van had broken down in Hayward.
Pascal weighed in at nine point four pounds at his checkup and the vet said the missing back leg has not slowed him down at all.
Rode thirty-four miles out on the Iron Horse trail and turned around at the Danville bench because the headwind was not worth it.
The Orange line sat at MacArthur for twelve minutes for a mechanical problem and the whole car quietly agreed to pretend it was normal.
Dropped the disk-fill alert threshold from five minutes down to ninety seconds so we stop finding out about it from the support inbox.
Rosa from the flat downstairs knocked to ask if my wifi was also dropping every evening around ten, and it turned out her baby monitor was the culprit.
There are now nine dashboards for one service and I can only explain what six of them are actually measuring.
Cut the p99 latency budget from 400ms to 250ms and moved the image resize step off the request path entirely.
Complained that my landlord finally replaced the boiler after six weeks, and the first hot shower was worth the wait.
Found the rear tyre flat in the hallway this morning with a staple through it, which is the third puncture since June.
Rode the Orange line in with a flat tire on the bike still strapped to my back, planning to fix it at the shop on Telegraph.
Adopted a three-legged tabby named Pascal from the shelter in March; he only drinks from the bathroom tap.
